name: Bodyweight squat
summary: Feet shoulder-width, sit the hips down and back until the thighs are about level, then stand.
setup: Face the phone, feet shoulder-width, toes a little out, arms in front. Sit down and back until the thighs are near parallel, knees tracking over the toes, then drive up to standing.
brief: Feet shoulder-width, toes a little out, arms in front. Sit down and back until the thighs are near parallel, knees tracking over the toes, then drive up to standing.
why: Facing the phone both knees are seen: depth from the knee angle, and the knees caving toward each other as the gap between them shrinking.
progression: Goblet squat; slower lowering; pause at the bottom.
contraindications: Knee pain at depth; unable to keep the heels down.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Heels lifting
faults.tip: Sit back into the hips; if the heels lift, raise them on a small plate for now.

faults.label: Tailbone tucking under
faults.tip: At the bottom the pelvis can tuck and round the lower back. Your depth ends just before that.

faults.label: Cutting depth
faults.tip: Go as deep as the heels stay down and the back stays neutral.

faults.label: Looking up
faults.tip: Craning up extends the neck. Look at a spot on the floor a few metres away.

guide.surface: Flat floor, flat shoes or bare feet.
guide.cannotSee: The back rounding and the hips travelling back — side-view details.

points.t: Track over the toes; stay apart at the bottom.
